description: First steps: the ideas behind CI/CD and Jenkins, and a first working pipeline.
Declarative Pipeline syntax: stages, directives, options and the features you use in any Jenkinsfile.
Where a build runs: agents, labels, executors and workspaces.
Branches, pull requests, tags, triggers and what runs where.
Running tests, publishing results and coverage, and dealing with flaky tests.
Linting, static analysis, quality gates and pipeline review.
Faster builds: parallel stages, matrix builds and dependency caches.
Secrets, credentials, scanning and supply-chain checks.
Docker agents, image builds, registries and cleanup.
AWS accounts, credentials and services such as ECR, ECS, S3 and Lambda.
Deploying, promoting and rolling back across environments.
Versioning and releasing: tags, changelogs, SBOMs and store builds.
Telling people how a build went: post actions, Slack and Teams.
Reading failed builds and fixing common pipeline errors.
Team conventions, roles and how to request changes.
Shared library steps that the pipelines call, and how to change them safely.
Node.js builds and frontends.
.NET builds and NuGet packages.
Java builds with Maven and Gradle.
C++ builds with CMake.
Android and iOS builds, signing and store releases.
